title: No Leaky Buckets: Why We Built IronLedger
summary: Save 100+ hours per month on expenses and invoices. We automatically collect, code and allocate credit card receipts for you.
body_markdown:
"I handed my property manager a $20 bill, and I told him to **toss it out the window** .
Because that's what happens every time we don't bill back a receipt" — Owner, 5K+ multifamily units, Based in Alabama


## Property management companies can leak cash


We spoke with over 100 owners and managers, and **leaking profits** was a common theme.


Accounting teams are either spending **dozens of hours** tracking card spend, or they're losing around **5% of profits** from missed billbacks.


My grandfather developed and managed real estate in Columbus, OH. We could be losing thousands of dollars a year from not properly reconciling our books.


With stronger processes, you reconcile everything, but it takes a team 40+ hours every month and is a nightmare to track and collect receipts.


We built IronLedger to solve this problem.


## IronLedger collects, codes and reconciles card spend with AI


Make a purchase and get a text immediately from IronLedger to collect your receipt.


Like a bookkeeper, IronLedger confirms the property, unit or PO number for you over text. It then handles complex splits for you and codes it accurately in seconds.


IronLedger works with **all credit cards** (including American Express, Visa, and Mastercard) and **all accounting systems** (including Rent Manager, AppFolio, and QuickBooks).


Stop spending hours tracking down and coding expenses. Use IronLedger.
